title: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points
question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?

prediction.sql:
WITH driver_season_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        res.driver_id,
        res.constructor_id,
        SUM(res.points) AS total_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, res.driver_id, res.constructor_id
    HAVING SUM(res.points) > 0
),
constructor_season_points AS (
    SELECT 
        dsp.year,
        dsp.constructor_id,
        SUM(dsp.total_points) AS constructor_total
    FROM driver_season_points dsp
    GROUP BY dsp.year, dsp.constructor_id
),
min_per_season AS (
    SELECT 
        csp.year,
        csp.constructor_id,
        csp.constructor_total,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY csp.year ORDER BY csp.constructor_total ASC) AS rn
    FROM constructor_season_points csp
),
constructor_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        mps.constructor_id,
        COUNT(*) AS min_seasons
    FROM min_per_season mps
    WHERE mps.rn = 1
    GROUP BY mps.constructor_id
)
SELECT c.name
FROM constructor_counts cc
JOIN constructors c ON cc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY cc.min_seasons DESC
LIMIT 1

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH last_races AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM races
    WHERE year >= 2001
    GROUP BY year
),
season_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        lr.year,
        ds.driver_id,
        ds.points as total_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN last_races lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    WHERE ds.points > 0
),
min_per_season AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(total_points) as min_points
    FROM season_totals
    GROUP BY year
),
fewest_drivers AS (
    SELECT st.year, st.driver_id
    FROM season_totals st
    JOIN min_per_season mps ON st.year = mps.year AND st.total_points = mps.min_points
),
constructor_counts AS (
    SELECT c.constructor_id, c.name, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM fewest_drivers fd
    JOIN results r ON fd.driver_id = r.driver_id 
        AND r.race_id = (SELECT last_race_id FROM last_races WHERE year = fd.year)
    JOIN constructors c ON r.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    GROUP BY c.constructor_id, c.name
)
SELECT name
FROM constructor_counts
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 1
